description: This file defines the class JavaValueFieldDefinition<T> which extends AbstractJsonFieldDefinition<T>. It represents a JSON field definition supporting arbitrary Java values within the Eclipse Ditto JSON project. The class includes methods for instantiation and retrieving Java typed values from JSON data.

classes.name: JavaValueFieldDefinition
classes.description: An immutable class representing a JSON field supporting arbitrary Java values, providing a way to define how JSON data maps to Java types within the project.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Factory method to create a new JavaValueFieldDefinition instance with specified pointer, value type, checking function, mapping function, and optional markers.

methods.name: getAsJavaType
methods.description: Overrides a method to convert a JsonValue into a Java type, returning null if the JsonValue is null, otherwise applying the provided mapping function.
